concerns.text: The plan never mentions any of the core entities defined in data-model.md (CityBoundary, RasterCovariate, TemperatureRaster, ModelResult). Each entity should be explicitly referenced in the relevant phase (e.g., ingestion creates CityBoundary objects, rasterization produces RasterCovariate records, model fitting outputs ModelResult entries).

No step in the plan cites the contract schemas (dataset.schema.yaml, metrics.schema.yaml, model_output.schema.yaml, output.schema.yaml). The plan should map its output artifacts (aligned dataset, metrics.csv, model output files) to the corresponding contract files to ensure validation.
